title: Clear AGV Motionless on Floor Fault Using RMS (If Needed), E-Stop Zone Map, and Blue RESET
summary: For an AGV motionless on the floor (fault), locate the faulted AGV (optionally using RMS to identify the AGV error), stop the appropriate E-stop zone using the E-stop zone map, remove the faulted AGV, pull the E-STOP, and press the blue RESET button to resume operation.
when_to_use: Use when an AGV is motionless on the floor and the issue is identified as a fault, requiring physical removal of the faulted AGV and an E-stop zone reset to resume system operation.
access_or_tools_needed: RMS / fleet status UI (if needed to identify the faulted AGV error)
Physical access to the appropriate E-stop(s)

access_required: RMS / fleet status UI (if needed to identify the faulted AGV error)
Physical access to the appropriate E-stop(s)

visual_references.description: RMS screen showing the AGV “Bump” fault with exception codes 21057 and 21060 (used as an example of how RMS may display the AGV fault/error).
HMI screenshot showing a faulted AGV with tote state (used to support identifying the faulted AGV context).
AGV API Controls screen (Remove AGV / Recover AGV / Pause/Resume / Execute/Resend commands) referenced by the manual for AGV management.

steps.title: Locate the faulted AGV (use RMS if needed)
steps.purpose: Identify which AGV is faulted so the correct E-stop zone can be stopped and the correct unit can be removed.
steps.instruction: If the faulted AGV is not immediately obvious, use the RMS / fleet status UI to identify the AGV error/faulted unit.
steps.expected_result: You have identified the faulted AGV that is motionless on the floor.
steps.healthy_condition: RMS indicates the faulted AGV/error state for the unit you are targeting for removal.
steps.failure_condition: RMS does not clearly identify the faulted AGV (or you cannot confidently determine which AGV is faulted).

actions.label: Check RMS for faulted AGV
actions.exact_action: Reference RMS for AGV error (if needed to locate the faulted AGV).

stop_or_escalate_if: If RMS does not clearly identify the faulted AGV, escalate for assistance locating the faulted unit.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: AGV motionless on floor — Corrective Action: Locate the faulted AGV (may need to reference RMS for AGV error).

source_evidence.retrieval_text: Locate the faulted AGV (possibly using RMS for AGV error).

steps.title: Stop the appropriate E-stop zone using the E-stop zone map
steps.purpose: Bring the correct zone to a stopped state before removing the faulted AGV.
steps.instruction: Reference the E-stop zone map and press the E-STOP for the appropriate E-stop zone.
steps.expected_result: The appropriate E-stop zone is stopped.
steps.healthy_condition: The E-stop you pressed corresponds to the zone for the faulted AGV identified in Step 1.
steps.failure_condition: You press the wrong E-stop zone (zone does not match the faulted AGV location).

actions.label: Press zone E-stop
actions.exact_action: Press E-STOP to stop the appropriate E-stop zone (per E-stop zone map).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Reference E-stop zone map. Press E-STOP to stop the appropriate E-stop zone.

source_evidence.retrieval_text: Reference E-stop zone map, press E-STOP for appropriate zone.

steps.title: Remove the faulted AGV
steps.purpose: Clear the physical fault condition by removing the faulted AGV from the system/floor.
steps.instruction: Remove the faulted AGV from the floor/system area.
steps.expected_result: The faulted AGV has been removed.
steps.healthy_condition: The faulted AGV is no longer present in the faulted location/zone.
steps.failure_condition: The faulted AGV remains in place (fault condition not cleared).

steps.title: Pull the E-STOP
steps.purpose: Complete the E-stop reset sequence before pressing blue RESET.
steps.expected_result: The E-STOP has been pulled (reset sequence is ready for blue RESET).
steps.healthy_condition: E-STOP is in the pulled state as part of the reset procedure.
steps.failure_condition: E-STOP is not pulled (blue RESET is pressed without completing the sequence).

steps.title: Press the blue RESET button
steps.purpose: Reset the system so operation resumes after the faulted AGV is removed and E-stop is pulled.
steps.expected_result: The system resumes operation after the reset.
steps.healthy_condition: System operation resumes (no longer remains in the faulted/stopped state).
steps.failure_condition: System does not resume operation after pressing the blue RESET button.
stop_or_escalate_if: If the system does not resume operation after pressing the blue RESET button, escalate.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Press the blue RESET button. The system will resume operation.

source_evidence.retrieval_text: Pull E-STOP; press blue RESET button; system will resume operation.

steps.title: Confirm the system resumes operation
steps.purpose: Verify recovery succeeded and the system is back to running.
steps.instruction: Confirm that the system resumes operation following the blue RESET.
steps.failure_condition: System remains stopped/not resumed after reset.
stop_or_escalate_if: If the system does not resume operation after pressing the blue RESET button, escalate.
